NativeTraceDefinition: Trace captured directly from the runtime candidate scoring pipeline, NOT from cross-system mapped shadow-adapter data. traceSource=PackageTrace(3).

Fields.name: operationId
Fields.description: The operation/scenario ID. For native collection, set by CurrentOperationId on sink accessor before pipeline execution.

Fields.name: requestId
Fields.description: Correlated request ID. Set by CurrentRequestId on sink accessor.

Fields.name: candidateId
Fields.description: Unique candidate identifier from the scoring pipeline.

Fields.name: authority
Fields.nativeSource: Derived from sourceType and section during MapTraceFields()

Fields.name: deterministicScore
Fields.description: Legacy bounded-additive score (11-dimension). Computed per section by ScoreWorkingMemoryForAnchors() etc.
Fields.nativeSource: c.Score from section scoring (11-dimension for memory, fixed for task/constraint/global)

Fields.name: strategyScore
Fields.description: Strategy-based feature score. Currently identical to deterministicScore (unified scorer not yet wired at runtime).

Fields.name: finalScore
Fields.description: Final blended score. Currently identical to deterministicScore (hybrid blend not yet wired at runtime).

Fields.name: selectedByScoring
Fields.description: Whether scoring selected this candidate. True by default; false for explicitly rejected items (deprecated constraints, lifecycle-filtered).

Fields.name: includedInPackage
Fields.description: Whether the candidate actually made it into the final package. False if dropped by token budget, dedup, or exclusion.

Fields.name: droppedReason
Fields.description: If not included, why. Examples: 'token budget exhausted', 'constraint is deprecated or rejected', 'filtered by lifecycle'.
Fields.nativeSource: Set during package assembly in BuildWithPolicyAsync()

Fields.name: tokenCost
Fields.description: Estimated token count for this candidate's content.
Fields.nativeSource: c.TokenEstimate or derived from content length

Fields.name: section
Fields.description: The package section this candidate maps to (current_task, hard_constraints, working_memory, global_context, recent_context, stable_memory, soft_constraints, related_context, or legacy raw doc name).
Fields.nativeSource: Section name from BuildWithPolicyAsync() loop context

VsV16_2_ShadowAdapter.V16_2_TraceSource: Cross-system mapped from vector/trace/shadow-adapter/ (vector allowlisting schema)
